promise_text: Revised EIT Law narrows defamation and hate-speech provisions
evidence_since: In force, but prosecutions continue. SAFEnet counted 34 online-expression cases in Jan–Mar 2025 and said most criminalisation cases still used Article 27A, with public figures (8) and public officials (5) the most frequent complainants (Forum Keadilan, 30 Apr 2025: https://forumkeadilan.com/2025/04/30/pelanggaran-hak-digital-di-indonesia-meningkat-safenet-soroti-tekanan-terhadap-kritik-publik/). In Apr–Jun 2025 it counted 29 cases, most often reported by politicians (6), public officials (5) and businesspeople (4) (BandungBergerak, 1 Aug 2025: https://bandungbergerak.id/article/detail/1599608/laporan-triwulan-ii-2025-safenet-kritik-terhadap-kebijakan-pemerintah-berbalas-serangan-digital).

promise_text: Only individuals can be victims of defamation; not companies, government bodies, officials or groups
evidence_since: Applied in Sept 2025: when the TNI cyber unit consulted Polda Metro Jaya about reporting Ferry Irwandi for defamation, the deputy cyber director said that under the ruling an institution cannot report; it must be a person (detik, 12 Sep 2025: https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8108069/putusan-mk-bikin-tni-tak-bisa-laporkan-ferry-irwandi). Watch: SAFEnet reports the new Penal Code's Article 433 (written defamation) starting to be used against legitimate expression, including against a woman activist in NTB reported by a public official (SAFEnet, Apr 2026: https://safenet.or.id/pelanggaran-hak-digital-awal-2026-meningkat-kuhp-baru-dan-ai-jadi-ancaman-serius/).

promise_text: Hate speech requires real and imminent harm
evidence_since: TO FILL: post-ruling 28(2) convictions without real, imminent harm (check Laras Faizati: charged under 28(2) but convicted under Penal Code Art. 161(1))

promise_text: National Police will obey the Constitutional Court ruling on the ITE Law
evidence_since: Followed in one public case: Polda Metro Jaya told the TNI cyber unit in Sept 2025 that an institution cannot report defamation (detik, 12 Sep 2025: https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8108069/putusan-mk-bikin-tni-tak-bisa-laporkan-ferry-irwandi). No written police circular or implementing guidance found as of Oct 2026; the Chief of Police's circular SE/2/II/2021 on the ITE Law predates the ruling.
